label: Stipulated covariation and survival without strict giving (inference)
rule: Check the cessation law and apply the productive bridge to the protected survivor
meaning: At date 1 the model stipulates covariation between protector presence and inducer absence through a shared world index. Causal prevention is one interpretation of that covariation. In the surviving history, the received bearer has an inertial reason and lacks any strict giver at 1, so the productive bridge fails there.
